CONFIRMED: THIS DEFECT FAILS ON MAIN ITSELF, not only on patchsets. The last scheduled branch-head run of test.yml (33824556786, 2026-09-04T01:07:53, schedule trigger on main) failed on 'build-and-test / pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)' and 'sweep (windows)'. So main's own health signal is red from this bug, independently of anything in review. That strengthens the priority-0 classification: it is not merely gating changes, it has taken out the branch-health signal that would tell us whether main is good.

Note the schedule cadence is roughly 6-hourly (06:55, 12:52, 18:48, 01:07), and test.yml is deliberately EXCLUDED from push-on-main -- the workflow's own comment explains why: its concurrency group cancels in-progress runs, and on main github.ref is the constant refs/heads/main, so every push cancelled its predecessor and rendered a healthy main as a trail of red X's. Branch health therefore comes from the schedule, meaning a defect like this one degrades main's health signal for up to ~6 hours before it is even visible.
